shots.focal_element: Stacked three-line title 'AI / Content / Brief' on the left, balanced by the MOZ logo in a rounded white card on the upper right
shots.transition_other: none: first shot, video opens directly on the title card
shots.typography: Very large heavy-weight sans-serif title, title case, tight-to-normal tracking, set left-aligned on three lines; 'AI' line carries a soft vertical gradient fill. Logo is the brand wordmark in caps. Font guess (low confidence): Lato Black or similar humanist sans.
shots.what_happens: On a diagonal gradient background the title builds line by line: 'AI' is present at 0.0 s, 'Content' rises in by 0.5 s with 'Brief' rising from below a mask, all three lines set by 1.0 s. The MOZ logo card is already on screen and settles slightly larger/lower; decorative elements (a small orb behind the card, an outline circle on its corner, two overlapping outline hexagons below it) pop in around 1.0-2.0 s and drift gently. Holds until the VO starts 'Tired' (w0) at the end of the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Full-bleed diagonal gradient; left column of three bold title-case lines each revealed with a masked slide-up staggered ~0.4 s, right side a rounded white logo card with a small gradient orb and outline circle tucked behind its corners plus two outline hexagons that scale/fade in and drift a few px with a slow rotate.

shots.focal_element: Stressed woman holding her head behind a desk, overlaid by a pile of composited browser/spreadsheet windows in the lower half
shots.transition_other: title card shrinks and slides away toward the lower left, uncovering the footage that is already underneath (exact path not resolvable at 2 fps)
shots.what_happens: At 3.5 s the title card is caught mid-exit as a smaller offset panel over the footage; by 4.0 s the frame is the full stock-style shot of a frustrated woman with many overlapping data/document windows layered in front of her. Image holds nearly static through 4.5 s while the VO says 'Tired of the content creation grind,' (w0-w5). Text in the windows is illegible placeholder UI.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the title-card group down to ~70% while translating it off-frame bottom-left over 0.4 s to reveal a background video layer, on which 6-8 flat screenshot windows of tables and documents are composited in overlapping stacks across the lower two thirds.

shots.focal_element: Single centered line of dark caption text on a horizontal pink-to-lavender gradient
shots.transition_other: gradient panel expands vertically over the footage (footage still visible in thin bands top and bottom at 5.0 s)
shots.typography: Medium-large bold sans-serif in near-black, sentence case (lowercase after 'You'), normal tracking, single centred line replaced phrase by phrase. Font guess (low confidence): Lato Bold.
shots.what_happens: A gradient panel covers the footage and the VO line is typed on in sync with speech: 'You k' grows to 'You know you need' (w6-w9), then the line is replaced by 'to write better-rank' completing to 'to write better-ranking' (w10-w13), then 'content' (w14) alone. At 7.5 s the panel fades out with the text, the stressed-woman footage showing through.
shots.build_rebuild: Full-frame horizontal gradient layer that scales in on Y from the centre, with a centred caption that types on character by character timed to the word timestamps and swaps to the next phrase on each pause, then crossfades the whole layer out to the footage underneath over ~0.3 s.

shots.focal_element: Frustrated woman's face framed above a wall of overlapping UI windows
shots.what_happens: The stressed-woman composite returns after the gradient crossfades away, now framed slightly tighter than in s002, under the VO 'but figuring' (w15-w16). The windows are larger and closer to camera than before, suggesting a continuous push-in. Only one sampled frame (0.3 s shot).
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade the caption layer out over the footage composite while a slow camera push-in (scale ~1.0 to 1.1) runs on the windows layer slightly faster than on the background to read as parallax.

shots.focal_element: Pile of composited data and document windows in front of the frustrated woman
shots.transition_other: no visible cut in the sampled frame; appears to be a continuation of the same push-in on the composite (detector split)
shots.what_happens: The windows have grown and spread outward relative to s004, crowding the frame edges while the woman's face stays centred; it reads as the windows expanding toward camera during 'out what' (w17-w18). Only one sampled frame, so the exact motion is inferred.
shots.build_rebuild: Continue the camera push: scale the foreground windows group up and spread each window outward from the centre by 5-10% of frame width while the background footage scales more slowly.

shots.focal_element: Central document window rising in front of the woman's face, with side windows peeling away and paper sheets flying
shots.transition_other: no visible cut in the sampled frame; appears continuous with s005 as windows fly outward (detector split)
shots.what_happens: The window pile keeps expanding: a large document window now covers the lower face, left-side windows tilt and fly off-frame and a sheet of paper flutters lower left, reinforcing overload under the VO 'to write and' (w19-w21). Single sampled frame; motion inferred from the change versus s005.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate each foreground window outward from the centre with slight rotation and perspective tilt plus scale-up and motion blur, and add a couple of paper-sheet sprites tumbling across the lower third, over ~0.5 s.
